translation: Na aana a Yiceraeri magiĩthĩkĩte thĩ ina mũthemba ũrĩa ũkũgera thĩinĩ wa ⟨the⟩ iriwa, na mai maatuĩkire gĩcigo kĩrĩa kĩrahũrire ibuku-inĩ rĩa woko wa wothũro we Mĩena ĩrĩ: kuruta ũguo maari, kana magegania ndarõ, na maikaririe tiga amwe marutwo kana agĩtigĩrũo kana hau.
